test: xlsx_read_untrusted: a second look at zips, paths, entities and sizes > what every sheet shares is read once for a workbook, however many sheets are read
evidence: It guards time, not a result. The old reader gave the same tables, but read the shared strings again for every sheet: a 63 KB workbook of 100 sheets held Import for over two minutes. They are now read once for a workbook.
